fields.description:
Give the Operator page a view of the Partners it has deals with, including key billing terms, derived from the Deal records rather than a direct Account-to-Account relationship.

=== FIELDS ===

* Target columns from the Aug 13 call: Partner / Partner Type / Payment Terms / Invoicing Cadence / Currency / AP Contact / PO Required / Deals (count)

=== IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ===

* TABLED per Kobi, Aug 17. Direction is settled even though the implementation isn't: the Operator-Partner relationship IS the Deal configuration — Deal is technically the junction object. The intent is to 'find a way to provide a subset of operator/partner info from there.' Not urgent; revisit after the Tue Aug 18 demo.

* The junction object was correctly ruled out on Aug 13 because billing terms never vary within a partner network — Lina: 'It would still be the same. It never changes... always the same within that partner network.'

* Note this is NOT a standard related list. Operator-Partner is many-to-many (BetMGM sits under both Catena and GDC, stated on the call), so it has to be derived. Candidate approaches when this resumes: the Deals Operator list grouped by Partner, an embedded report chart, or an Apex-backed LWC.

* Marc's parallel thread — standard ParentId vs a custom lookup, gated on sharing settings (Slack Aug 13 03:15) — resolves the same way: no direct relationship, so neither.

=== NOTES ===

* Taryn's doc calls this 'the biggest open question in this doc' and marks it resolved on the basis of 'still Deal-derived, no direct relationship.' That is now confirmed as the right read — Kobi stated it explicitly on Aug 17 — but the implementation is deliberately parked.

* BUILD-140 (Operators on Partner) is the mirror image and is parked with it.

=== SOURCE ===

* Taryn doc OP-10

* Aug 13 call — junction ruled out

* Kobi Aug 17 — Deal is the junction, table for later

Dependencies: Deal-derived approach, design TBD

Owner (proposed): TBD

Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.

Created 2026-08-17 from the Operator/Partner ticket review, approved by Kobi.
